source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 4 REGRESSION TESTS for ISS-0937. Write the fail-first regression tests exactly as specified in lib/letflow/design/iss0937-month-boundary-test-clock.md section 3 (read it fully): (a) new test/support/partition_clock_test.exs (pure oracle iterating today over >=24 (design says 48) months incl. every 1st/2nd and boundary dates; independent oracle for eligibility mirroring lib/letflow/event_store/partition_maintenance.ex's rule; source-scan test for the old derivation if designed) and (b) a new `ISS-0937` describe in the existing test/support/tenant_template_test.exs (hand-built schemas with fixed names, e.g. reference with events_y2026m10 vs candidate with events_y2026m09, calling the real check_table_set/assert_clone_parity! path as designed; a genuinely extra non-partition table must still raise; fixed partition tables still compared). Tests must not read the real date. Do NOT modify the already-implemented fix files except to expose something strictly needed (state it if so). FAIL-FIRST PROOF REQUIRED (WF-03 Step 4): in a THROWAWAY git worktree (e.g. ../letflow-4-wf03-iss0937-prefix created from origin/main, with this branch's NEW test files copied in plus only the minimal stub needed to compile - for partition_clock_test the pre-fix state has no PartitionClock module or the old -1 derivation: per WF-03 'code under test does not exist' section you MUST additionally MUTATE the shipped logic and record which tests fail per mutant: at minimum mutant 1 = offset -1 instead of -(N-day-aware) (old derivation: shift_months(month_of(today), -1)), mutant 2 = filter regex loosened to hide any events_* table / or filter applied only to missing side (the original bug). For the parity tests run them against origin/main's tenant_template.ex (pre-fix) and record they FAIL there with real output, then PASS on the branch. Apply mutants only in the throwaway worktree (deps can be copied from ../letflow-4/deps or junctioned), remove the throwaway worktree afterwards (git worktree remove --force), and confirm `git status --porcelain` of the branch worktree shows only your new/changed test files. Then run on the branch: mix format --check-formatted on the new files, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test for the new/changed test files plus the three retention files and tenant_template/tenant_fixture tests; quote pass counts. Do not commit; ORCH commits. Record in the handoff result.summary: per-test pre-fix fail output/post-fix pass, mutant table with pass/fail counts, and the final owned_modules. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED, result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'.
acceptance_criteria: Fail-first proven against pre-fix code with real output
Mutants applied and recorded in throwaway worktree, removed

result.summary: PASS. New: test/support/partition_clock_test.exs (6 tests), test/support/tenant_template_test.exs (+7 tests, new 'ISS-0937' describe, helper build_schemas!/2), test/specs/ISS-0937.md. No fix files modified. FAIL-FIRST (throwaway worktree from origin/main + only the new test files): 13/23 passed, 10 failed: all 6 partition_clock tests (PartitionClock undefined / retention files lack PartitionClock) and 4 parity tests (stale dynamic partition on candidate: 'table set: extra=["events_y2026m09"]'; events_archive variant: extra=["events_archive_y2026m09"]; reference-only: extra=["events_y2026m11"]; non-partition extra: extra=["events_y2026m09", "widgets_extra"]). The 3 guard tests (missing non-partition, invalid names, fixed events_default extra) pass pre-fix by design (anti-vacuity guards). Branch: 23 passed. MUTANTS (fix applied in throwaway worktree, each reverted and baseline re-verified 23 passed; counts are failed/23): M1 PartitionClock ignores N (legacy month_of(today)-1): 3 fail (eligible-every-day, legacy-regression, boundary dates). M2 offset -2 over-conservative: 2 fail (latest-eligible, boundary dates). M3 filter applied to reference side only (candidate unfiltered = original bug): 6 fail (4 ISS-0937 parity + 2 real-replay template parity tests). M4 filter applied to candidate side only: 0 fail -- EQUIVALENT mutant (missing side is already filtered by the full req376 predicate, so reference-only dynamic tables cannot surface). M5 filter loosened to hide any events* table: 2 fail (invalid-names, fixed events_default extra). M6 regex month part loosened to m[0-9][0-9]: 1 fail (invalid names m13). (First M6 sed was malformed -> regex matched nothing -> 7 fail; discarded and redone.) M7 filter disabled entirely: 4 fail. M8 retention_operations_test.exs reverted to legacy shift_months(current_month(), -1): 1 fail (source scan). Throwaway worktree removed (git worktree remove --force + prune); main checkout untouched. BRANCH VERIFICATION: mix format --check-formatted on both new/changed files OK; mix compile --warnings-as-errors OK; mix test test/support + the 3 retention files + test/letflow/support: 107 passed (4 properties, 103 tests), 0 failures; mix letflow.check.test: second run exit 0, 16 partitions all 0 failures (~5156 tests incl. properties), 'OK -- isolated :lua_wallclock_race run also passed clean'. CAVEAT: the FIRST mix letflow.check.test run exited 1 ('real test failure/error') and its partition logs were no longer on disk, so the failing test is unidentified; the rerun was fully green. Not reproduced; ORCH/TEST-RUNNER should watch for a flaky test. git status --porcelain: only test/support/tenant_template_test.exs (M), test/support/partition_clock_test.exs (new), test/specs/ISS-0937.md (new), plus this handoff. Final owned_modules: test/support/partition_clock_test.exs (new), test/support/tenant_template_test.exs, test/specs/ISS-0937.md (new); fix files from step 03 unchanged.
